message.content: The commit `ce37922e Revert to returning yyterminate() from the lexer when an error is found.` is interesting. This is directly related to the lexer error handling and the double-free. Let me look at this commit.

content:
commit ce37922e2641e1be876a029a6b1020f919d52b8c
Author: Victor M. Alvarez <vmalvarez@virustotal.com>
Date:   Wed Nov 8 12:26:04 2017 +0100

    Revert to returning yyterminate() from the lexer when an error is found.

    This aborts the lexer, causing the parser to return a spurious "syntax error, unexpected $end", but if yyterminate() is not called it has other negative effects, as the parser continues executing while some tokens can have associated invalid data (for example an _IDENTIFIER_ token with a NULL c_string)
